name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v524: Cookie freshness check on app open - if saved cf_clearance is older than ~30 min, the invisible WebView solves Cloudflare in the background before you tap play. Invisible WebView toggle added to settings. Pre-flight probe throttled to once per minute and skipped entirely when the cookie is fresh. Stream-link cache (~20 min) so re-tapping the same episode doesn't re-hit AnimePahe. One canonical AnimePahe domain only. All previous v523 features retained: Phisher-style bottom sheet UI, 70% WebView, auto-save/dismiss, mouse cursor, purge/poll/auto-dismiss.
